name: Can I update my home’s style without losing its original character?

mainEntity.name: Can I update my home’s style without losing its original character?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many projects blend modern functionality with preserved elements such as original floors, trim, stair details, or fireplaces, creating a balanced look that honors the home’s roots while feeling current.
